label: Multi-Dimensional Scaling (MDS)
type: the Couchbase Server architecture in which each service is independently placeable, independently quota'd and independently scalable across named nodes
note: The load-bearing concept of services.md, and it has NO CAPELLA COUNTERPART in the corpus - that absence is itself the finding. Capella's ~180 management-plane pages (rounds 6-9) expose cluster configurations, node counts and service checkboxes, with placement decided for the user; nothing there needed server:node, server:rebalance or server:service-memory-quota. The ontology therefore holds two disjoint views of the same services - server/ sees deployable components with topology, Capella sees a managed feature list - joined only by the shared service:* ids.
relates_to_competency_question: How do I scale one service without scaling the rest?
